canon_contract.entry: F1-03 locked outcome: the Hobbits reach Bree.
canon_contract.p1c02_runtime_exit_note: A chapter-local runtime postcondition is not promoted here; runtime implementation remains predecessor-gated.

canon_spatial_anchors: Bree sits beneath Bree-hill within a small inhabited Bree-land.
The settlement is gated at night and organized around old road crossings.
The Prancing Pony is a large inn and social meeting place for locals, travellers and Rangers.
Bree includes both Men and Hobbits; population identity must not be flattened into a single generic crowd.
world_contract.landmark_rule: Town gate and inn must remain dominant navigation/cinematic anchors.
world_contract.streaming_rule: Partition by sightline/portal logic and preload the next critical area before transition.
